svg.title: Scrubbing: how the viewport follows the replay, and the keys
svg.desc: Storyboard of four follow rules plus mouse and keyboard table.
svg.text: How the viewport follows the replay · mouse and keys · open points
The viewport stays where it is
A pulse in the author’s colour and a small name flag
mark the cell. Nothing scrolls, nothing jumps.
Scrolls (≤ 250 ms) so the cell lands in the upper third,
leaving room to see what is around it.
A tab that did not exist yet is simply missing from the
tab bar until the replay reaches its creation, then it
Moving the view yourself ends following for this replay.
The chip, or stepping to another row with the checkbox
continuous; view follows when you pause
¹ proposed, to check against GNOME and Firefox shortcuts
Stepping onto a chat message with #tags makes the
viewport follow the first tagged object.
Newer changes from others keep arriving; a count shows
Read-only everywhere. Restore stays the owner/editor
Rail is a slider for screen readers: “16:21, ann set F6”,
announced politely. With reduced motion the view jumps
1 Wheel over the panel normally scrolls a list. Proposal: it steps the replay while the replay is on, Ctrl+wheel scrolls the list.
2 Should the “Changes / Conversation” filter decide what a step is? Proposal: yes, steps only visit rows that are visible.
3 Chat while replaying: allowed, it goes to the live document. Tags typed then point at the live state, not the past one.
